Owner/Auditor gates add 0.05–1 working day (mode 0.25); BLOCKED tasks add 0.5–5 days (mode 1).

# TKT-020 · G2-06 soak 60 mnt: spek job ronde (laporan)

Status: SPEC READY · G2-06 = NOT_TESTED (belum ada soak 60 mnt pada HEAD game `31f9360`). Bukti soak terakhir: `/srv/rm/docs/evidence/169_parity_r35z2/soak_1610/soak_report.md` (17 Nov, 15+15 mnt, PASS) = SUPERSEDED (lebih tua dari HEAD, fase hanya 15 mnt, simpan/muat 3/3).

## 1. Baris JOBS untuk rantai ronde
Antrean ronde kosong (`$SW/p0rNNs_patches.txt` berisi 0 baris) agar `apply_queue` tidak memasang patch di tengah soak:

```
env ROUND=p0rNNs RM_ROOT=/srv/rm JOBS=soak SOAK_MIN=120 bash /srv/rm/repo_tools/tools/qa/runner/run_round.sh > p0rNNs_nohup.log 2>&1
```

- `SOAK_MIN` = total; job membagi dua: fase `w15x_on` 60 mnt lalu `w15x_off` 60 mnt (run_job.sh `soak`). 120 dipilih karena dunia pemain bawaan = 15× nyala (IG90), jadi fase itu sendiri harus 60 mnt. `SOAK_MIN=60` (30+30) lebih murah tetapi fase 15× hanya 30 mnt → paling tinggi PARTIAL untuk G2-06.
- Jalankan sebagai ronde tersendiri di ujung rantai (sesudah ronde tests/uidev), bukan bersama job lain.

## 2. Durasi + RAM
- Per fase: 60 mnt + boot/bangun dunia ±1–3 mnt (r35z2: fase 15 mnt = ±16 mnt jam dinding). Batas waktu job `TO = 60*60+900 = 4500 dtk` per fase.
- Total ronde: ±2 j 10 mnt – 2 j 20 mnt (+ BuildDefines/compile awal ±5–10 mnt; tanpa refresh karena antrean kosong).
- RAM: satu Editor Unity (xvfb, UNITY_RENDER=1). r35z2: managed ±60 MB, native teralokasi ±740–860 MB, cadangan ±1,6 GB; working set Editor diperkirakan 3–4 GB. Mulai hanya bila RAM bebas ≥ 3,1 GB (CLAUDE.md, `ram_wait` di job); penjaga membunuh bila working set > `SOAK_WS_MB` 6144 MB. Disk: ±beberapa MB (CSV + log), tidak ada PNG.

## 3. Aturan lulus G2-06 (per fase; keduanya wajib)
Otomatis oleh `tools/qa/soak_report.py` (ambang milik Auditor, tidak dilonggarkan):
1. `exceptions = 0` (Error dicatat, tidak menggagalkan sendiri) + JOBLOG `exceptions=0`.
2. Memori sesudah pemanasan 5 mnt (regresi linear): managed ≤ 1,0 MB/mnt, native ≤ 2,0 MB/mnt; pertumbuhan bersih managed ≤ 64 MB, native ≤ 128 MB.
3. FPS Editor: median ≥ 20, min 1 dtk ≥ 5 (bukan angka HP).
4. `done = true`, ≥ 2 fase, `hang_guard.txt` kosong (penjaga: 900 dtk pembuka tanpa sampel, lalu 150 dtk tanpa sampel baru, atau working set > 6144 MB → kill + FAIL).

Diperiksa orkestrator dari `soak_report.json` (alat otomatis lebih longgar di dua butir ini; lihat TKT tindak lanjut 1):
5. Simpan/muat: `saves_ok ≥ 5` dan `saves_fail = 0` per fase (jadwal tiap 300 dtk → 60 mnt menghasilkan 12 siklus; 5/5 = minimal lima siklus pertama semuanya `ok`). soak_report.py sendiri hanya menuntut ≥ 1.
6. Durasi: `minutes ≥ 60` untuk fase `w15x_on` (run_job.sh memanggil `--min-phase-min` dijepit ke 10).
7. HEAD game di log ronde = SHA yang diklaim; tidak ada patch dipasang di ronde soak.

Satu butir gagal atau tak terbaca = FAIL (ragu = FAIL). Bukti: `/srv/rm/docs/evidence/169_parity_p0rNNs/soak_<HHMM>/soak_report.md` + `.json` + `soak_w15x_{on,off}_samples.csv` + `editor_{on,off}.log`.

## 4. Patch sisi game
Tidak ada yang kurang: `HubHUD.Soak.cs` + `DeviceOverride.cs` (soak_devprof_p12) dan penjaga gagal-cepat `Scene3DCapture.Run` (soaklinux_r28) ada di HEAD `31f9360`; `SoakSaveLoad` sudah memakai simpan sinkron paksa sejak perf_p07_asyncsave_v2_r580 (commit `b04cc24`), jadi simpan → baca tidak membaca simpanan basi. Ronde ini cukup memakai alat yang sudah ada.

Catatan: job ini adalah soak **Editor PlayMode** (sesuai keputusan 16 Nov "uji soak otomatis di Editor"), bukan build pemain/HP. Kinerja HP tetap di G2R.

## Tiket tindak lanjut
- TKT-F1 (Auditor, lajur L7/QA alat ukur): `tools/qa/soak_report.py` + `tools/qa/runner/run_job.sh` — tambah `--min-saves 5` dan teruskan `--min-phase-min` = menit fase (tanpa jepit 10) agar butir 5–6 dinilai otomatis; hanya mengetatkan, tidak melonggarkan.
- TKT-F2 (opsional, Claude, L7): job runner `soakplayer` (Player build uji dengan `-soak`, penjaga hang pemain 2,5 GB/120 dtk disesuaikan ke jeda sampel 30 dtk) bila Director menginginkan soak di build pemain, bukan Editor; tanpa perubahan kode game.

tickets.report_md:
# TKT-058 report · G1-07 Unity exit 3 in scene jobs + ui15x 960x540 "unfinished"

Sources (read-only): `/srv/rm/docs/evidence/169_parity_p0r37u/` (job_*.log, scene15x_*/metrics.txt, editor.log, motion.csv, ui15x_960x540_1157/), `/srv/rm/scratch/p0r37u_nohup.log`, `/srv/rm/RenewableCEO/Library/JobRunner/supervisor.log`, `/srv/rm/repo_tools/tools/unity/job.sh`, `/srv/rm/repo_tools/tools/qa/runner/{lib.sh,run_job.sh}`, game code under `/srv/rm/RenewableCEO/Assets` (read-only). Unity and the runner were not touched. No tools were changed and no thresholds were loosened.

## 1. Exit code 3 is not a crash. It is the MotionLock FAIL signal, sent on purpose

- It happened in all **4** scene15x jobs (clinic, warung, lamp, pump), not only in clinic and warung. supervisor.log:653/655/657/659 shows `Unity exited code=3` at 10:56:03, 11:17:40, 11:38:20 and 11:52:33, the same times as the job ends. traffic15x and grid15x exit with code 0.
- Cause: `Assets/Scripts/Game/UI/Screens/HubHUD.Scene3DShot.cs:497-503`. When the scene ends, it writes metrics.txt, frames.tsv and motion.csv, runs `MotionLock.Check(mcsv.Text, …)`, and then calls `ShotQuit(lockFails > 0 ? 3 : 0)`. The `ShotQuit` at :521-527 calls `EditorApplication.Exit(code)`. Comment :496: "kunci regresi gerak; gagal = job adegan keluar kode 3 (FAIL), berkas bukti tetap ditulis" (motion regression lock; a failure makes the scene job exit with code 3 (FAIL), and the evidence files are still written). Every scene3d job ends the editor this way, with code 0 or 3.
- The wording is misleading. `tools/unity/job.sh:52-62`: for any job still running when the editor exits, the supervisor writes `"Unity exited with code {c} during the job (runner restarted)"`. Exit code 0 gets the same text (traffic15x/grid15x: `status ok … code 0 … runner restarted`).
- "try1" does not mean a retry happened. `runner/lib.sh:59` `runjob` loops only when the message contains "free RAM". Every job log has only `try1` (0 lines with `try2`). The job ran once, the evidence is complete, and `log_exceptions=0`. TKT-048 O4 ("the retry succeeded") misread this.
- The runner does not use the exit status (no `exited`/`exitCode` handling in run_job.sh, lib.sh or round_gate.py). The I3 lock blocks come from the separate LOCK lines. So exit 3 has no side effect on the verdict or on rollback, but its information is lost.

What MotionLock flagged (metrics.txt `motion_lock … FAIL`, the same line in each editor.log):

| Scene | foot_gap | slide_contact | off_asphalt |
|---|---|---|---|
| clinic | 39, max 249.1 cm, ERI:reach@90.8 | 3.8 cm KDS:l@58.7 | 130 TRK@38.7 |
| warung | 39, max 197.0 cm, ERI:reach@115.8 | 3.8 cm ERI:l@81.6 | 540 TRK@38.7 |
| lamp | 4, max 43.7 cm, ERI:reach@81.0 | 3.8 cm ERI:l@62.2 | 180 TRK@38.7 |
| pump | 3, max 66.2 cm, ERI:idle@56.0 | 3.8 cm ERI:l@67.7 | 130 TRK@38.7 |

Three independent contributors. Exit 3 stays until all three are gone:
1. **foot_gap**: clinic and warung are the ladder bug from TKT-048 B1/B2 (SceneDirector.cs:1716-1726 / 2063-2066), fixed by queued r645 (p0r38). The lamp `reach@81.0` is probably the same climb→reach path. Check it in p0r38. The pump `idle@56.0` (66 cm) is not explained by the ladder path, and the I3 lock metric shows 0 for lamp and pump. The difference between the MotionLock foot_gap and the I3 foot_height_over_2cm is an Auditor question.
2. **slide_contact 3.8 cm** in all 4 scenes (walk, `l@…`): this is TKT-048 F4 and is still open. It is not covered by r645.
3. **off_asphalt TRK**: this is a measurement mismatch in the 15× world, not a vehicle behaviour problem. `Scripts/Game/Characters/Motion/MotionCsv.cs:235-236` classifies `off` with the legacy `DriveGrid.Get().ClassAt(c) == DriveGrid.Road`. In 15× that grid does not describe the 15× roads, so **all 1128 TRK rows** in clinic motion.csv have `off_asphalt=1`, even the parked ones. MotionLock.cs:141-144 counts the non-park rows. The 15× tool `tools/qa/lane15x.py` measures `off_asphalt15x_frames=0` for the same scenes (its line 46 already documents the I11-vs-15× gap).

## 2. The ui15x 960x540 "unfinished" job is a false alarm (TKT-048 O1/F1)

The TKT-048 report was written at **12:08:21** (file mtime), while the job was still running. Afterwards, `shots_summary.json` was written at 12:10:00: `{"shots":102,"pass":102,"planned":102,"png_written":102,"verdict":"PASS"}`. `_audit/summary.txt` and `metrics15x.txt` were written at 12:10:07, the job log (1222 B) contains HASIL + LOCK RINGKAS gagal=0, and nohup.log:129 has `JOB_DONE ui15x 960x540 12:10:07`. prog_rows has the HASIL row. The "103 planned / 102 png" and the empty log were a mid-job snapshot. Nothing needs fixing in the game or the runner.

## 3. Smallest fix proposals

- **P1 (runner proposal for the Auditor; tools only, no threshold change)**: in `runner/run_job.sh`, the scene/scene15x branch (:46, :111), after `runjob`, add a line when the job's done json has `exitCode` 3: `MOTIONLOCK FAIL (exit 3 = MotionLock.Check, bukan crash): <motion_lock line from $D/metrics.txt>`. Also in `tools/unity/job.sh:62`: for code 3, the message becomes "scene job ended: MotionLock FAIL (exit 3)" instead of "runner restarted". This is information only. The lock verdict stays with the LOCK lines.
- **P2 (measurement tool, owned by the Auditor; not a loosening, because the 15× metric already shows 0)**: in `MotionCsv.cs:235`, when World15x is on, classify `off` with the 15× road model (the same source lane15x.py uses) instead of the legacy `DriveGrid`. Otherwise exit 3 stays permanent in every 15× scene even after r645 + F4. It is the Auditor's decision. No game patch was made for this.
- **Game**: no new patch. foot_gap → r645 (already queued for p0r38). slide_contact 3.8 cm → F4 (SceneDirector walk contact, after p0r38 proves r645). Pump `idle@56.0` 66 cm → diagnose after p0r38 if it still appears.
- **Process**: before writing a report that calls a job "unfinished", check `JOB_DONE <job>` in `p0r*_nohup.log`.

## 4. Status

Exit 3 has been classified as **code (the deliberate MotionLock FAIL signal), not environment** (RAM 13.4–14.6 GB free at each restart, no crash). The ui15x 960x540 job finished with 102/102 PASS. G1-07 is still NOT_MET because of the I3 blocks (r645 pending) and the open MotionLock contributors (F4 slide, off_asphalt 15× measurement).

# TKT-073 · malam 15×: jendela menyala vs LitCount (p0r37u)

## Angka (Goldmeadow, log WINTER_NIGHT di uidev_a57_1014/player.log)
| Tangkapan | Zoom | Lit / kavling | Jendela menyala terukur | Catatan visual |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| wn_map_build_night | BUILD (LOD0) | 209/397 (0,526) | win_lit = 209 = LitCount (ok) | warm 0,15 % FAIL (min 0,50) |
| wn_map_mid_night | MID | 209/397 | win_lit 209 (pengukur hanya LOD0) | warm 0,02 % → CONDITIONAL_PASS (rasio < 0,60) |
| 94_r9c_roof_close_night | MID (rumah = LOD tengah) | 0,526 (save T5 Lv60) | dilihat: ±15–20 rumah berjendela kuning, semuanya rumah 2 lantai (homestay/ruko); rumah H1–H6 tanpa jendela | — |
| 93_r9c_roof_build_night | FAR | 0,526 | 0 jendela (impostor kotak) | sesuai desain FAR |
| 49_home_t5_night | plaza/dekat | — | jendela + lampu menyala di gedung plaza dan rumah dekat | sebagian tertutup modal "Naik tingkat" |

## Putusan
1. "Sedikit jendela" di FAR/MID sebagian besar BENAR: rasio elektrifikasi 0,526, FAR tidak pernah menampilkan jendela, dan rumah H1–H6 (326/397) di MID memakai LOD H tanpa jendela (aturan 19 Nov: MID boleh agregasi halus, tanpa cahaya palsu). Di BUILD/LOD0 jendela menyala = LitCount (209 = 209).
2. BUG di MID: rumah tanpa LOD H/LOD1 prefab — TOWN-HOMESTAY-HC3 (59) + TOWN-BAKERY-HC3 (12) = 71/397 — memakai proto penuh berjendela di LOD tengah (`RegionMapBuilder.cs` Build: `Place(mid, hasLod ? lo : p, ...)`), sedangkan lapis gelap `ElecWindows15x.Build` hanya LOD0 (`lg.SetLODs(new[] { new LOD(lod0, ...) })`). Akibatnya di MID ke-71 rumah itu menyala tanpa memandang Lit (perkiraan ±34 menyala palsu pada rasio 0,526), dan jendela yang terlihat di 94 bukan cerminan LitCount. Pengukur WinterQa juga tidak melihatnya (sensus LOD0 saja).

## Patch
`/srv/rm/scratch/wip_tkt073/vis_nightlit15x_TKT-073.patch` (+ manifest, LENGKAP): lapis jendela gelap ikut LOD tengah hanya untuk kavling tak berlistrik tanpa LOD H (salinan material yang sama, `_NightGlow` 0; tanpa cahaya baru); sakelar `ElecWindows15x.MidDarkOn`. Compile offline TOTAL 0. Belum diuji di Unity: perlu EditMode ElecWindows15xR407Tests + tangkapan 94/wn_map_mid_night.

## Bukan cakupan ini
- warm BUILD 0,15 % < 0,50 dengan win_lit benar = soal kecerahan jendela/palet (TKT-004/028), bukan jumlah.
- Lit rumah H1–H6 tidak tampil sama sekali di MID (LOD H tanpa slot jendela) — sesuai keputusan 19 Nov; bila ingin agregasi halus MID, itu keputusan desain, bukan bug.
- Sensus WinterQa sebaiknya juga mengukur LOD tengah (alat ukur = Auditor).

# TKT-075 · Integration review p0r39..p0r49 (read-only) · 27 Nov 2026

I reviewed the combined tree (HEAD plus every queued patch, compile-checked) together with the patch and manifest files. I made no code changes. Each risk lists the patches involved, file:line in the combined tree, the likely symptom, the round where it should first appear, and the smallest fix. I found file overlaps by scanning the diff headers. Everything not covered here touches only one file per patch.

## Ranked risks

**1. Two owners for the "Lihat di Peta" camera (HIGH)**: TKT-023 × TKT-050
- `HubHUD.Small.cs:386-391` calls `Select("map")` and then `SceneCamera.Snap()`. `HubHUD.cs:788` sets `PetaOpen=true`, so `WideWanted` turns on. At `HubHUD.cs:807-809` the camera jumps to `FrameSize` 18 (the whole island) and `Apply()` runs.
- Snap runs only when `_scene3d?.Cam != null`. In the `_smallScene`, queued-job, or no-scene paths the Peta stays at 18. On the next LateUpdate, `RegionCamera.cs:191` runs `PetaTabOld15x.Tick` (the skip applies only to Onboarding/Intro) and can hand off to the old-island overview.
- For a site in another region, `Effective` + `Allowed` (`RegionCamera.cs:193-196`) clamps focus back to the HQ region.
- Symptom: "Lihat di Peta" shows the whole island or old map, not the crew. This is the IG21 37–40 regression coming back.
- Round: p0r46, the first round with both patches (IG21 run 2 / 13_small_running → map).
- Mitigation: set `_mapFocusOverride` = site before `Select("map")` when `WatchSiteSnap`, so the camera takes the size-9 path at `HubHUD.cs:808` and never touches FrameSize. One line, under the existing switch.

**2. Intro beat framing vs RegionCamera clamp (HIGH, needs checking in the p0r47 log)**: TKT-023 × TKT-064
- `HubHUD.IntroShots.cs:51-58` locks the camera, sets `WholeIsland15x.Intro=true` and size h1=FrameSize. TKT-023 widens only MaxSize. Focus is still clamped to the region (`RegionCamera.cs:139-141`, `Step` 183-197). `Step` has no `Locked` check, unlike `OfficeStep`/`HubStep`.
- The TKT-064 beats A1/A5 (Island, focus `_introIsland`) and A2/A3 (Coast/Jetty) can put focus outside the HQ region's Bounds/`Allowed`. The coroutine sets focus in Update and RegionCamera clamps it in LateUpdate (`IntroShots.cs:530-535`, `:125-151`).
- Symptom: island 01 is not centred and the sea is missing on one side, or the camera jitters through the beat. The beat log is correct, but the rendered frame differs.
- Round: p0r47 intro capture (tools_v20 G3).
- Mitigation: in `RegionCamera.Step`, when `WholeIsland15x.Intro && _cam.Locked`, skip the focus clamp (same pattern as `OfficeStep`), behind its own switch. Verify by logging the focus after LateUpdate against `pose.focus` for A1/A3/A5.

**3. Small projects with no dialog at all (HIGH, product rule)**: TKT-049 × TKT-054
- `HubHUD.Small.cs:446-447`: `busy` (a scene running or any `RunningSmallJobs`) means `StartSmall` is called directly with no opener.
- TKT-054's `LoneCloseGuard` (`SmallDialog15x.cs:73`, `HubHUD.Small.cs:58` `CloseFor` only when the opener played) then drops the closer as well.
- Before TKT-054 such jobs at least got a closer. The two patches together give 0/2 dialogs for every second parallel job and for work-hours auto jobs. This breaks the 16 Nov decision "every quest has an opening + closing dialog".
- `HubHUD.AutoShot.cs:176` also calls `StartSmall` directly, so captures never show this case.
- Round: p0r47.
- Mitigation: (a) when busy, defer the opener until the scene is free, or (b) leave `LoneCloseGuard` OFF until (a) exists. Lead/Director must decide which.

**4. Night warm metric pushed down by two patches (MED)**: TKT-004 × TKT-073 (+ TKT-028)
- `NightGrade.cs:80` `WindowGlow` changes #F6B840 → #FFCE76: brighter, saturation about 0.54 instead of 0.74.
- `ElecWindows15x.cs:28` `MidDarkOn=true` puts a dark layer at MID on houses without power.
- Each patch is correct alone. Together they lower MID/FAR warm% under the D-B1-1 rule (CONDITIONAL_PASS above the electrification threshold needs warm ≥ 0.25 %). MID night could flip to FAIL even though nothing is broken.
- `NightWindowsR20Tests.cs:19-61` locks the separate constant `MapWindowGlow`, so the shared window colour and the Peta window colour can drift apart.
- Round: p0r43 night captures 46/49/53.
- Mitigation: the Auditor confirms that the warm-hue band in the classifier covers #FFCE76 and compares warm% p0r43 vs p0r38 at the same LitCount before giving a verdict. Report raw warm%.

**5. DRAFT assets shown to players by default (MED, policy)**: TKT-065
- `PlazaStreetB15x.Enabled=true` (bawaan NYALA). Its manifest says it adds a "row of DRAFT B houses" on the Beranda plaza.
- Rules of 18 Nov: DRAFT is allowed only in pilot tests, PASS ≠ APPROVED, and visual switches stay OFF for players.
- On the same screen, `HqLotMarkers15xOn`, `HqRiseClose15xOn` and the TKT-026 HQ class all default ON, so one Beranda capture cannot tell which patch caused a change.
- Round: p0r42.
- Mitigation: default OFF in the build, or record Director approval for the asset. Capture Beranda per switch (A/B) once.

**6. HQ-rise moment while the whole-island frame is on (LOW-MED)**: TKT-023 × TKT-051 × TKT-024
- `HubHUD.Onboarding.cs:758-770` moves the camera in to 3.5 u while `WholeIsland15x.Onboarding` is still true (`HubHUD.cs:432-433`). The whole-island frame keeps rendering, and `HqMarkerAlwaysShown(picked‖reco‖hqLot)` keeps the marker on the unchosen lot.
- Symptom: a lot pin or marker on top of the HQ rise frame, and a heavier frame during the rise.
- Round: p0r46 capture of HQ pick → rise.
- Mitigation: hide the lot markers once `_company.HqTile` is set.

**7. Shared files and cross-patch test assertions (LOW-MED)**
- `RegionMapBuilder.cs` is touched by 4 patches (TKT-003/011/027/062), `WholeIsland15x.cs` by 3 (011/023/038), and `GhostRegions15x.cs` by 2 (011/032). TKT-011 adds 6 colour/text assertions that later colour patches (027 mapwhite, 038 roofs) can contradict.
- `HubHUD.AutoShot.cs` is touched by 3 capture patches (TKT-007/029/042). TKT-023 changes the Peta size to FrameSize, which shifts the framing of 39/48 map_overview and the TKT-042 region captures.
- Mitigation: run full EditMode on the cumulative stack after p0r42, not per patch. When a test fails, roll back the cause patch only (per the runner rules).

**8. Localisation consistency (LOW)**
- strings.csv is touched by 9 patches. I checked that no key is edited twice and that `{kw}`/`{place}` survive in the c15.qd rows.
- Risk: RU (TKT-037, p0r45) was written before TKT-047/056/057 (p0r47–49) changed ID/EN, so the RU text may be stale for those rows.
- Mitigation: one loc lint (missing or stale RU, character limits from UI_COMPONENT_SPEC) after p0r49.

## Summary
Risks 1–3 should be handled before G2 evidence from p0r46/p0r47 is accepted. Each needs only a small, switched change or a Lead/Director decision (3). Risks 4–8 are measurement or policy checks. Red lines: none touched by this review.

tickets.report_md:
# TKT-091 report: u-round throughput (read-only analysis, 27 Nov 2026)

Sources: `/srv/rm/scratch/p0r37*_nohup.log`, `p0r38*_nohup.log`, `docs/evidence/169_parity_p0r37u/` (job logs, file mtimes, `perf/player/player_perf.log`), `RenewableCEO/Library/JobRunner/{supervisor.log,done/*.json,*.log}`, runner `repo_tools/tools/qa/runner/{run_round.sh,run_job.sh,lib.sh}`. Nothing was started, stopped or written apart from this file.

## 1. Where the time goes: p0r37u (JOBS = build, perfshot, uidev a57+small16x9, lock15x)

**Total for p0r37u: 09:15:47 → 12:27:22, which is 3 h 11.6 min.** The parent round p0r37 (patch, reimport, EditMode tests) adds 7.6 min. For p0r38u, build plus perfshot took 74.5 min, against 58.0 min for the same two steps in p0r37u. That puts p0r38u on track for about 3 h 30 min.

| # | Step | Start → end | Min | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Gate, freeze, snapshot, BuildDefines + recompile | 09:15:47 → 09:16:14 | 0.5 | Reuses the Editor already running from p0r37, so no cold start |
| 1a | Build: `WorldSliceBuilder.Build()` (scene regeneration) | 09:16:23 → 09:40:30 | **24.1** | 13,220 "PluginImporter version 1" warnings. These are the same 4–8 GoogleMobileAds metas re-read about 3,300 times, which means about 3,300 separate AssetDatabase import/refresh cycles |
| 1b | Build: `BuildPipeline.BuildPlayer` (Linux64) | 09:40:30 → 09:42:05 | 1.6 | The actual player build is cheap |
| 2 | perfshot (player, 50 rows = 5 configs × 10 screens) | 09:42:06 → 10:14:08 | **32.0** | Player reports t=1880 s. Same row set in p0r36u: 1685 s; in p0r38u: **2574 s** (+37 %, every row slower → CPU contention or variance) |
| 3a | uidev a57 2340×1080 (player, 102 screens) | 10:14:08 → ~10:30:25 | 16.3 | |
| 3b | uidev small16x9 960×540 (player, 102 screens) | 10:30:30 → 10:42:47 | 12.3 | |
| 4 | nnscan | 10:42:47 → 10:42:59 | 0.2 | |
| 5 | scene15x clinic (Editor, cold start) | 10:42:59 → 10:56:06 | 13.1 | Boot to first frame took 1.5 min |
| 6 | scene15x warung | 10:56:03 → 11:17:44 | **21.6** | Boot 1.3 min. Capture ran 20 min: 487 frames at 1280×720, each 4th frame, about 2.5 s per saved frame on llvmpipe |
| 7 | scene15x lamp | 11:17:40 → 11:38:23 | **20.7** | Boot 1.6 min |
| 8 | scene15x pump | 11:38:20 → 11:52:35 | 14.2 | Boot 1.7 min (`-jobmin 3.5`) |
| 9 | traffic15x | 11:52:33 → 11:56:09 | 3.6 | Boot 1.4 min |
| 10 | grid15x + hc165 compare | 11:56:06 → 11:57:52 | 1.7 | Boot 1.3 min |
| 11 | ui15x 960×540 (player, 102 screens) | 11:57:52 → 12:10:07 | 12.3 | |
| 12 | ui15x 1920×1080 (player, 102 screens) | 12:10:07 → 12:27:22 | **17.3** | |
| 13 | Verdict + bookkeeping | 12:27:22 | ~0 | |

Totals by category:
- **Editor capture (scene/traffic/grid):** 74.9 min. Of this, about 8.8 min is 6 cold Editor starts, because every scene3d job ends with Unity exiting (code 3 or 0) and the supervisor restarts it.
- **Player UI captures (uidev ×2, ui15x ×2):** 58.2 min, run one after another.
- **Build:** 25.7 min, of which 24.1 min is world regeneration.
- **perfshot:** 32–44 min.
- **Waits:** `ram_wait` and `disk_ok` never triggered: free RAM stayed at 13.4–14.8 GB and disk had 71–91 GB free.

## 2. Ranked savings (none removes or loosens a check)

| Rank | Saving (min / u-round) | How | Where (file:line) | Auditor? | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **10–23** | Stop the 24-min world regeneration from paying for one import per asset. (a) Wrap the asset-writing parts of the builder in `AssetDatabase.StartAssetEditing()/StopAssetEditing()` (try/finally) so the DeleteAsset+CreateAsset loops import in one batch. Estimate 10–18 min; to be measured. (b) Additionally, skip `WorldSliceBuilder.Build()` when an input hash is unchanged since the last successful build. Inputs: `Assets/Editor/World/**`, `Resources/World/**`, region JSON, referenced art. Record the cache hit and hash in `build_stamp`. Saves about 23 min when the round's patch does not touch world inputs. | `RenewableCEO/Assets/Editor/Build/WebBuild.cs:65` (`WorldSliceBuilder.Build()` before BuildPlayer `:69`); per-asset writes at `Assets/Editor/World/WorldSliceBuilder.cs:684-685, 1432-1433, 1554-1555`, refresh loop `:1239-1241`, `MapDecorBuilder.cs:371-372, 438-439, 527-528, 613-614`; runner `tools/qa/runner/run_job.sh:75` | (a) **no**: build pipeline, not a measuring tool. It does need one A/B proof that the scene and generated assets are byte-identical (sha256 over `Assets/Resources/World` + scene). (b) **yes**: stale-build risk, evidence identity | (a) medium: deferred import can make a later `LoadAssetAtPath` in the same builder return null, so wrap only leaf loops and verify. (b) medium: a hash that misses an input gives a stale world; mitigate with conservative inputs and a forced rebuild on every non-u round |
| 2 | **25–35** (wall clock) | Run the player-only UI captures (uidev a57/small16x9, ui15x 960/1920: 58 min) **in parallel with** the Editor jobs scene15x/traffic15x/grid15x (75 min). Keep the same commands, the same outputs and the same locks; only the scheduling changes. perfshot stays exclusive. 8 vCPU, Unity uses about 5.8 cores, RAM about 14 GB free, so expect each to slow down, hence net 25–35 min, not 58. | `tools/qa/runner/run_round.sh:53` (uidev) and `:69-72` (scene15x / traffic15x / grid15x / ui15x sequential); `run_job.sh:86-89, 139-140` (the player jobs call `"$J" stop`, which would kill the Editor, so the parallel path must not stop the JobRunner) | **yes**: scene15x motion/lane metrics and UI settle timing (`HubHUD.AutoShot.cs:85,99,167…` uses WaitForSecondsRealtime) could shift under CPU contention | medium-high: run one shadow round and compare locks against a sequential round before adopting |
| 3 | **~12** | De-duplicate **uidev small16x9 (960×540, safe 0)** and **ui15x 960×540**. Both are 102-screen autoshots of the same player build at the same resolution (World 15× is the player default since IG90; ui15x passes `-world15x on`). Use one player run and write both metric sets: uidev locks and ui15x / NN03–05 / x15power locks. | `run_job.sh:86-89` vs `:139-140`; `run_round.sh:53, 72` | **yes**: evidence source changes for two lock families | low-medium: first prove that the screen list and flags are identical (one-time diff of both runs' png names + metrics) |
| 4 | **0–12** (variance) | Make perfshot exclusive on the CPU: no agent builds, Codex, Mission Control jobs or Blender while it runs (heavy.lock already exists). The same 50 rows took 1685 / 1880 / 2574 s across p0r36u/37u/38u, and every p0r38u row was slower, which points to contention. This also makes the perf gate numbers more trustworthy. | `run_job.sh:82-83`; `lib.sh:56-57` (add a CPU/load wait next to `ram_wait`; e.g. wait until loadavg < 2 before perfshot) | no (scheduling only; makes the measurement stricter, not looser) | low |
| 5 | **5–7** | One Editor session for all six Editor capture jobs: 4× scene15x + traffic15x + grid15x. Today each job ends with Unity exiting and the supervisor restarts it, costing 1.3–1.7 min of boot + A2 library + scene load each time (8.8 min total). | `run_job.sh:109-116, 124, 128` (each `runjob scene3d`); JobRunner exit after scene3d (`Assets/Editor/Automation/JobRunner.cs`, scene3d handler) | **yes**: a fresh process per scene is currently implicit state isolation; carried state could change motion metrics | medium |
| 6 | ~1 | Order: run the Editor capture jobs (rows 5–10) straight after build while the Editor is still up, then the player jobs (perfshot, uidev, ui15x). This saves the stop at `run_job.sh:82` plus one cold start. Worth more if combined with #5. | `run_round.sh:49-53, 68-72` | no | low |

Not recommended, because each would reduce what is checked: fewer perfshot rows per u-round (only Seimbang feeds the gate, but the `lama`/`Tinggi`/`Hemat` rows are evidence), lower `-maxframes 600` or `-capspeed`, or JPEG/lower-resolution scene frames.

## 3. Realistic outcome
- #1a + #4 + #6 need no Auditor approval (only the A/B identity proof for #1a): about **3 h 11 m → about 2 h 45 m**, and p0r38u-type rounds lose their +12 min variance.
- Adding the items that need Auditor approval (#1b, #2, #3, #5): about **1 h 55 m – 2 h 10 m**.
